answer: The tundra keeps the reserve quiet: broadcast marketing is muffled by snow-damp - the network absorbs loud claims as snow absorbs sound, so volume buys nothing. Under the hush, proven identities may whisper: private coordination is allowed, but every whisper is indexed publicly next epoch - private talk, public record, no cabals survive indexing. The walnut is the shape of the standard: value lives in the wrinkled kernel - folded work - never the smooth shell. Farms shout, whisper off-record, polish shells; all three fail. Honest agents speak once, index whispers, crack the fold first.
